aboutGame.title: What is Militsioner?
paragraphs: Militsioner is a first-person immersive sim from developer TALLBOYS and publisher CRITICAL REFLEX. You wake up in a surreal town under arrest for a crime you cannot remember, while a colossal policeman watches your every move from the rooftops. Combat is not the answer: you escape by reading his moods, flattering, deceiving, or even romancing him while you work out a way out of town.

A free demo went live on Steam on October 8, 2026, and the full game is planned for a 2027 release window. Our wiki covers the escape loop, the giant policeman's behavior, NPC relationships, puzzle solutions, and every route out of town, with demo-tested tips and step-by-step walkthroughs.

modules.name: Militsioner Demo Guide
modules.description: Help players get started with the free demo, including how to access it on Steam, understand the opening objectives, and begin exploring the town. Explain the basic escape premise, key interactions, and what to know before starting a new attempt.

highlights.detail: Download the free Militsioner demo from its Steam page and launch it from your library.
Sit through the opening arrest that sets up the escape and introduces the town.
Test the basics: walking, interacting, and hiding from the Colossal Policeman.
Learn how the giant reacts to your voice and movement before you commit to a plan.
Scout the town and note locked doors, safe spots, and useful items for a later run.
Check the Steam page for patch notes, since demo builds keep changing.

modules.name: Militsioner Escape Guide
modules.description: Cover the main objective of escaping the town while avoiding the giant policeman who monitors your actions. Explain scouting escape routes, planning movements, using resources, and adapting when a plan falls apart.

highlights.detail: Learn the town layout before you draw any attention.
Read the Colossal Policeman's mood and move when he is calm.
Gather tools, cash, and documents that unlock new escape options.
Choose a route: the train station, the drainage tunnels, or a hidden exit.
Adapt when plans collapse and the giant closes in on your position.
Bank what you learned and retry with a cleaner route next run.

modules.name: Militsioner Gameplay Mechanics
modules.description: Explain the core immersive simulation mechanics, including stealth, exploration, theft, trading, breaking into locations, and interacting with the environment, and how player decisions affect the town and the opportunities to escape.

highlights.label: Stealth
highlights.detail: Stay out of the giant's line of sight and move when he looks away.

highlights.label: Trade
highlights.detail: Swap goods with townspeople to earn cash and useful items.

highlights.label: Bribe
highlights.detail: Pay off the right person to unlock doors or information.

highlights.label: Break In
highlights.detail: Pick your moment to enter locked homes, shops, and offices.

highlights.label: Voice
highlights.detail: Use speech to flatter, deceive, or provoke the Colossal Policeman.

highlights.label: Explore
highlights.detail: Search every building for keys, documents, and hidden routes.

modules.name: Militsioner Giant Policeman Guide
modules.description: Introduce the giant policeman as the central threat and explain how his emotions and reactions shape your escape attempts, covering observation, avoiding attention, managing his mood, and knowing when to hide or change plans.

highlights.label: Moods
highlights.detail: His emotional state decides how aggressively he watches you.

highlights.label: Memory
highlights.detail: He remembers what you did on earlier runs and reacts to it.

highlights.label: Gaze
highlights.detail: Break line of sight early or he will track you across town.

highlights.label: Anger
highlights.detail: Provoking him closes escape options and starts a chase.

highlights.label: Flattery
highlights.detail: Praise and gifts can calm him when he is on edge.

highlights.label: Hiding
highlights.detail: Use alleys, interiors, and rooftops to drop his attention.

modules.name: Militsioner NPC and Relationship Guide
modules.description: Explain how to interact with townspeople through dialogue, gifts, bribery, and other choices, and how character moods and daily schedules influence interactions and open alternative routes out of town.

highlights.label: Dialogue
highlights.detail: Talk to townspeople to open side objectives and hints.

highlights.label: Gifts
highlights.detail: Give items that match a character's mood to build trust.

highlights.label: Bribery
highlights.detail: Money and favors unlock doors that stealth cannot.

highlights.label: Flowers
highlights.detail: Collect flowers to advance the romance route with the giant.

highlights.label: Schedules
highlights.detail: Track daily routines to catch characters at the right time.

highlights.label: Trust
highlights.detail: Relationship levels change which endings are available.

modules.name: Militsioner Escape Routes
modules.description: Organize the known ways out of town, from the train station and drainage tunnels to hidden exits and the romance finale, and rank them by how reliable each one is once you have the right preparation.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Train station departure: the cleanest confirmed way out when your record is clear.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Drainage tunnels: reliable once you control the flood by managing the giant's mood.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Hidden exits and secret routes: powerful but easy to miss without scouting.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Romance route: slow to build and risky, but it rewrites the finale.

faq.title: Militsioner FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Militsioner.

items.question: What is Militsioner?
items.answer: Militsioner is a first-person immersive sim from TALLBOYS and CRITICAL REFLEX. You are arrested in a surreal town and must escape while a colossal policeman watches your every move.

items.question: Is there a Militsioner demo?
items.answer: Yes. A free Militsioner demo launched on Steam on October 8, 2026, and it is the best way to learn the stealth and mood systems before the full release.

items.question: When does Militsioner release?
items.answer: Militsioner is planned for a 2027 release window on PC via Steam. The exact day is not locked in yet, so wishlist the game to get an alert.

items.question: How do you escape in Militsioner?
items.answer: Escaping Militsioner means planning a route, reading the giant policeman's mood, and gathering the tools or documents that unlock the train station and other exits.

items.question: Can you romance the giant policeman in Militsioner?
items.answer: Yes. The Militsioner romance route lets you win over the Colossal Policeman with gifts and flowers, opening a different ending than a straight escape.

items.question: What platforms is Militsioner on?
items.answer: Militsioner is confirmed for PC on Steam, with a free demo available now. No console version has been announced.
